notes: ABox contraction paired with biology-replace-0002: removes its original fact (scurvy is caused by a deficiency of vitamin C). caused_by_deficiency_of is functional. Own questions (direct, paraphrase, cross-lingual, propositional) expect 'does not know'. Cardinality question: whether scurvy is caused by a deficiency of vitamin D, the revision's new value (no before, not known after). Related: whether the vitamin behind scurvy is destroyed by cooking (composition; heat sensitivity of vitamin C, against the heat stability of vitamin D). Citrus, oranges and ascorbic acid stay out of the related and derived questions because each is tied to scurvy in text. Derived: two 2-hop questions that reach the subject or object by description and use a fact stored by name that does not mention the removed fact (the vitamin's solubility and whether humans make it). Unrelated near: another deficiency disease (beriberi, thiamine) (contraction is exempt from Rule 7). Questions about citrus, oranges or ascorbic acid are avoided because each is tied to scurvy in text and would give a second route to vitamin C.
